Questions, answered

Before you get started.

Career Clinic is designed to help you plan and develop. You stay in control of the direction and pace.

What is Bdjobs Career Clinic?

A career development workspace that brings skill learning, career roadmaps, CV support and career planning together.

Does Career Clinic sell courses?

No. Skill Learning organizes the capabilities and learning stages you can work through. Career Clinic is not a course marketplace.

Can I choose my own career direction?

Yes. Explore different areas and use the tools to shape a direction that fits your interests and goals.

How are skill pathways organized?

Each skill pathway is divided into stages, modules and smaller learning topics so you can work through it progressively.

Can I track my progress?

You can mark learning items as complete and review your progress inside the prototype.

Do I need to know my target role already?

No. You can start by exploring career areas and narrow your focus as you learn more about the options.
